title.narrative: Transformational Energy Use for Sierra Leone - Phase 1 (TEUSL 1)

description.narrative: TEUSL 1 will promote the productive use of energy be households and MSME not connected to the national electric grid. Thus, targets group are people living in off grid areas and electricity will be mainly provided by solar minigrids or stand alone sytems (pico solar systems or home solar systems) in areas hard to reach by minigrids. TEUSL 1 is a pilot action, which will be extanded by a second phase to develop the results of the pilot taken into account the lessons learnt.
